_comment: Clips committed to this repository, named by the hash VoiceService looks up. Built by tools/bake_voice_bank.gd; do not edit by hand.

44630204f04396e9a8d1f8d3a251a4abf71c32a6.speaker: Corwin
44630204f04396e9a8d1f8d3a251a4abf71c32a6.text: There is a gentleman coming who will want to read my ledger, serjeant, and I cannot recommend it as literature.

72a871bd2376a94b4657f1eee94383fa383589b9.speaker: Wenna
72a871bd2376a94b4657f1eee94383fa383589b9.text: No more do you stand at that door since first light for the view of it, Father.

9f6619a0d36993460dafa84b9faa4e40e8eec35e.speaker: Maud
9f6619a0d36993460dafa84b9faa4e40e8eec35e.text: She bought two loaves of me that morning, and she a girl who ate like a sparrow. I have said it to nobody but you.

cd5a07f3913232cca4fe82e51eb1f02e0b4c2efb.speaker: Aldric
cd5a07f3913232cca4fe82e51eb1f02e0b4c2efb.text: Six days the river has held its tongue, and I have never known it keep a thing so long.

ceb0a55d902711644fe767cb1396b57c75440537.speaker: Serjeant Hale
ceb0a55d902711644fe767cb1396b57c75440537.text: Then mend it before he comes. I have troubles enough that will not be mended by Sunday.

db5106689603204ca33de539a20c4384ec6a964a.speaker: Father Brannoc
db5106689603204ca33de539a20c4384ec6a964a.text: You have come down the hill again, Wenna, and you never come down it for the good of your health.
